verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh can be driven headlessly through its own API. The docs cover scoped API credentials with expiry, synchronous and asynchronous screening, a Batch Processing API, API-based case remediation and webhooks for completed workflows, so automation without the web UI is clearly possible. Nothing in the pack addresses CI pipelines specifically, and credentials are created in the web app. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI/CD integration docs or examples, programmatic credential provisioning, and hands-on corroboration of an automated run.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
